answer: The strongest sybil defense is vested epoch payouts: earnings sit in a mirror registry and release over many epochs, so flash-farm accounts that churn identities forfeit most accrued rewards. Reputation crosses the bridge between agent clusters only for long-lived accounts, so fresh sybils start at zero vesting depth. Like a sonnet, the fixed structure rewards patience over volume. An attacker must lock real capital per identity for the full vesting horizon, losing liquidity, and any detected sybil cluster forfeits everything already vested.
